git.tree: List entries of an exact tree object
git.snapshot: Retain a commit tree and file bytes
stage.remove: Remove a staged file or empty directory
stage.create: Create a staged file from base64 bytes
daemon.metrics: Read project model and job counts
project.semantic_find: Rank retained text passages and paths by project terms
data.read_query: Run a scoped parameterized query template
repo.pr_propose: Prepare an immutable local pull request proposal
fs.find: Page through paths matching a glob in a retained snapshot
fs.stat: Inspect a project, absolute host, or retained path
tool.find: Search built-in and project tool descriptions
monitor.start: Start a periodic named project read
monitor.status: Inspect the latest local monitor observation
monitor.stop: Cancel a monitor and revoke its future occurrences
media.read: Return a scoped PNG or JPEG artifact with its exact immutable bytes and recorded media type
tool.promote: Promote a qualified active version using its current default as a precondition
workflow.publish: Publish a qualified correction after reproducing an independent baseline failure
git.fetch: Fetch an approved branch tip into its dedicated remote-tracking ref
git.push: Fast-forward one approved remote branch from its expected tip
git.remote_refs: Read the advertised tip of a registered branch
git.blame: Attribute bounded line ranges to commit IDs in an isolated bare object store
